title: KTF-001: Daylight unattended run — evidence capture (fix v2)
description: Single-packet daylight evidence capture. Verifies KTF-RP prerequisites, records the DP-01 worktree output, captures queue/initiative/git state, and writes a unified evidence report. Designed for a single free-exec worker pass — no inter-packet file dependencies.

packets.title: Capture unified daylight run evidence
packets.objective:
Execution class: free-exec. One outcome only. Verify KTF daylight proof prerequisites exist and capture a unified evidence report to docs/research/ktf-004-daylight-evidence-v2.md.

Step 1 — verify current-main runtime contracts. These must exit 0:
  git merge-base --is-ancestor f9dfb6a HEAD
  ./kitty builder initiative doctor --json

Step 2 — verify the DP-01 worktree output exists at the expected path. Run these and capture exit codes (not required to exit 0 — log what you find):
  test -f /Users/jacobbrizinski/Projects/kitty/.worktrees/kittybuilder/kb_ms7ps19u_1f33/docs/research/ktf-004-daylight-prerequisite-verification.md || echo 'dp01:worktree-file-absent'

Step 3 — collect evidence by running:
  ./kitty builder queue status
  ./kitty builder initiative status ktf-004-daylight-proof-v1
  ./kitty builder initiative status ktf-004-daylight-evidence-v2
  git log --oneline -5

Step 4 — write docs/research/ktf-004-daylight-evidence-v2.md containing:
  daylight-evidence-v2: captured
  inspected-head: <git rev-parse HEAD>
  captured-at: <date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ>
  ktf-runtime-on-main: <git merge-base --is-ancestor result>
  builder-doctor: <./kitty builder initiative doctor --json summary>
  dp01-worktree-evidence: present|absent
  dp01-verification-content: <cat the dp01 verification file or "unavailable">
  ktf-004-daylight-proof-v1-status: <initiative status summary>
  queue-status: <queue status summary>
  git-log: <5 most recent commits>

Step 5 — run final validation:
  git merge-base --is-ancestor f9dfb6a HEAD
  ./kitty builder initiative doctor --json
  test -s docs/research/ktf-004-daylight-evidence-v2.md
  grep -q 'daylight-evidence-v2: captured' docs/research/ktf-004-daylight-evidence-v2.md

STOPPING RULE: if Step 1 fails, make no change and fail the attempt. Step 2 is informational and does not stop the packet. If Step 5 fails, make no change and fail the attempt. Do not edit any other file, apply a manifest, claim an extra task, push, or create a PR.
acceptance_criteria: The evidence report exists only after all Step 1 checks pass.
The report captures the queue, initiative, and git snapshot at capture time.
No source, test, manifest, Builder database, Git remote, or GitHub state is changed.
